WITH distinct_visits AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT session, stamp, option, path
  FROM activity_log
  ORDER BY session, stamp, path
),
numbered AS (
  SELECT *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY session ORDER BY stamp, path) AS rn
  FROM distinct_visits
),
consecutive_details AS (
  SELECT a.session, a.rn, a.path AS detail1, b.path AS detail2, c.path AS third_page
  FROM numbered a
  JOIN numbered b ON a.session = b.session AND b.rn = a.rn + 1
  LEFT JOIN numbered c ON a.session = c.session AND c.rn = a.rn + 2
  WHERE a.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/') AND b.path IN ('/detail', '/detail/')
)
SELECT session, rn, detail1, detail2, third_page
FROM consecutive_details
ORDER BY session, rn
